segments.text: ALmightie and euerlaſting God, whiche arte alwayes more ready to heare then we to praye: And art wonte to geue more then either we deſire or deſerue: Powre down vpon vs the aboundaunce of thy mercy, forgeuing vs thoſe thinges wherof our conſcience is afrayde, and geuing vnto vs that that our prayer dare not preſume to aſke: through Ieſus Chriſt our Lorde.
